general.a: TravelHub is a unified travel platform where you can find and book tours, hotels, flights, excursions, guides, photographers, and other travel services.
Yes! We use data encryption and secure payments. Funds are reserved and transferred to the seller only after the service is provided.
You can email us at info@travelhub.az, call +994 XX XXX XX XX, or message us on Telegram @travelhub.

booking.a: Select a service, specify dates and number of travelers, add to cart and place an order. You'll receive a confirmation via email.

booking.q: Can I book multiple services at once?
booking.a: Yes! Use the trip builder or add different services to your cart. They will all be processed in one order.

booking.q: How to get a booking confirmation?
booking.a: After payment, you'll receive an email with confirmation and booking details. The information is also available in your dashboard.

payment.a: We accept bank cards (Visa, MasterCard), Apple Pay, Google Pay. Payments are encrypted.
Yes, installment plans are available for some services. Check details during booking.
The main currency is AZN. USD, EUR, and RUB are also available with automatic conversion.

cancellation.a: Yes, the cancellation policy depends on the service. Many services allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before start.
Upon cancellation, the refund is processed to your card within 5-10 business days.

cancellation.q: What if the service doesn't match the description?
cancellation.a: Contact our support within 24 hours after the service is provided. We'll investigate and help resolve the issue.

account.a: Click 'Sign up', choose a role (buyer or partner), fill in your details and confirm your email.
Go to Settings → Security → Change password. Or use 'Forgot password' on the login page.
Yes, go to Settings → Account → Delete account. Note that this action is irreversible.

partner.a: Click 'Become a partner', choose a partnership type, fill in the form and wait for moderation.
The commission ranges from 5% to 15% depending on the service type and sales volume.
Payouts are processed weekly to your bank account. The minimum payout amount is 100 AZN.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.text: By using the TravelHub platform, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree with any of the terms, please do not use our service.

sections.heading: 2. Registration
sections.text: To use certain features, you must register an account. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your account.

sections.heading: 3. Booking
sections.text: When booking, you enter into a contract directly with the service provider. TravelHub acts as an intermediary for payment processing. Prices are listed in AZN and may change.

sections.heading: 4. Payment and Refunds
sections.text: Payment is processed through secure payment gateways. The refund policy depends on the specific service and provider.

sections.heading: 5. Liability
sections.text: TravelHub is not responsible for the quality of services provided by sellers. We provide a platform for buyer-seller interaction.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.text: All materials on the platform are copyrighted and owned by TravelHub.

sections.heading: 7. Dispute Resolution
sections.text: All disputes are resolved through negotiation. If no agreement is reached, disputes are submitted to the court at TravelHub's location.

sections.heading: 1. Information Collection
sections.text: We collect information you provide directly: registration data, booking and payment data, messages and reviews, settings.

sections.heading: 2. Information Usage
sections.text: We use your information to process bookings, improve the service, send notifications and ensure platform security.

sections.heading: 3. Data Sharing
sections.text: We do not sell your data to third parties. Data is shared with service providers only to fulfill bookings.

sections.heading: 4. Security
sections.text: We use SSL/TLS encryption, secure data storage, and regular security checks.

sections.heading: 5. Your Rights
sections.text: You have the right to: access your data, correct inaccurate data, delete your account, unsubscribe from newsletters.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies
sections.text: We use cookies to improve user experience, analytics, and content personalization.
